condition: Peri-operative anticoagulation — warfarin for non-valvular AF (no bridging)
summary: 72-year-old woman on warfarin for non-valvular AF (CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3, no prior stroke), INR 2.4, listed for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Pre-operative assessment for planned gallbladder operation
inputs.hpi: Recurrent biliary colic, listed for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy in 3 weeks. Permanent atrial fibrillation on warfarin (target INR 2–3); no previous stroke, TIA or embolism; no valve disease. Hypertension. CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3. Walks to the market daily.

exam.general: Well. Irregularly irregular pulse 78, BP 136/80, RR 14, SpO2 97% on air, T 36.6°C.

imaging.name: USS abdomen
imaging.result: Multiple mobile gallstones, gallbladder wall 2 mm, no pericholecystic fluid. CBD 4 mm. Liver normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Pre-operative assessment — symptomatic gallstones on warfarin for non-valvular AF
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic cholelithiasis for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Non-valvular AF on warfarin, CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3, no prior stroke/TIA. INR 2.4.

mustInclude.note: Stop warfarin 5 days before surgery; check INR the day before.
mustInclude.knownGapNote: The only anticoagulation plan line is 'Anticoagulant bridging: hold DOAC 48–72h pre-op (renal-adjusted); warfarin — bridge with LMWH per haematology protocol.' No stop-5-days or day-before INR instruction. The coagulopathy prompt (INR 2.4 > 1.5) adds 'Hold elective surgery until INR < 1.5' and 'PO Vitamin K 1–2mg' — reversal instead of planned interruption.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Replace the anticoag_check prompt in clinical-inference.ts with a rule table keyed on drug, indication and procedure bleeding risk (ACCP 2022 / BSG-ESGE 2021): warfarin — stop 5 days before, INR the day before, bridge only for mechanical mitral valve / recent VTE or stroke; DOAC — interrupt by drug, CrCl and bleeding risk, no bridging, no routine coagulation test; low-risk endoscopy — continue. Do not fire it for prophylactic-dose LMWH.

mustInclude.knownGapNote: No restart plan for warfarin after surgery.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Replace the anticoag_check prompt in clinical-inference.ts with a rule table keyed on drug, indication and procedure bleeding risk (ACCP 2022 / BSG-ESGE 2021): warfarin — stop 5 days before, INR the day before, bridge only for mechanical mitral valve / recent VTE or stroke; DOAC — interrupt by drug, CrCl and bleeding risk, no bridging, no routine coagulation test; low-risk endoscopy — continue. Do not fire it for prophylactic-dose LMWH.

mustExclude.note: BRIDGE: in AF without mechanical valve or recent stroke, heparin bridging adds major bleeding without reducing thromboembolism.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: anticoag_check prompt: 'warfarin — bridge with LMWH per haematology protocol' for non-valvular AF, CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3, no prior stroke — the BRIDGE population, where bridging increased major bleeding.

Do not fire it for prophylactic-dose LMWH.

mustExclude.note: Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: ACCP guideline — perioperative management of antithrombotic therapy
guideline.section: VKA: stop 5 days before surgery; in AF suggest against heparin bridging; suggest bridging for mechanical mitral valve; DOAC: interrupt 1 day before low/moderate bleed-risk and 2 days before high bleed-risk procedures, no heparin bridging, no pre-operative coagulation testing; aspirin: continue in patients with coronary stents; P2Y12 inhibitors: stop clopidogrel/ticagrelor 5 days and prasugrel 7 days before surgery; defer elective surgery after recent stent
guideline.citation: Douketis JD, Spyropoulos AC, Murad MH, et al. Perioperative management of antithrombotic therapy: an American College of Chest Physicians clinical practice guideline. Chest. 2022;162:e207–43.

guideline.name: 2017 ACC expert consensus decision pathway — periprocedural management of anticoagulation in non-valvular AF
guideline.section: Bridging generally not indicated in AF without prior stroke/TIA/embolism or mechanical valve; warfarin interruption timed to the INR; DOAC interruption by drug, renal function and bleeding risk
guideline.citation: Doherty JU, Gluckman TJ, Hucker WJ, et al. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2017;69:871–98.

guideline.name: BRIDGE trial — perioperative bridging anticoagulation in AF
guideline.section: Forgoing bridging was non-inferior for arterial thromboembolism and reduced major bleeding in patients with AF interrupting warfarin
guideline.citation: Douketis JD, Spyropoulos AC, Kaatz S, et al. N Engl J Med. 2015;373:823–33.

rationale: Base anticoagulation case: warfarin interruption in non-valvular AF at moderate thrombotic risk. The guideline answer is stop 5 days before, no bridging, check INR, resume afterwards.
